name: Z9
summary: The A. O. Smith Z9 RO Water Purifier features 8-stage RO + Silver Charged Membrane Technology (SCMT) to deliver 100% RO-purified, baby-safe drinking water.
intro: The A. O. Smith Z9 is a premium 8-stage RO water purifier featuring Silver Charged Membrane Technology (SCMT) for 100% RO-purified, baby-safe drinking water. It offers instant warm (45°C) and hot (80°C) water through an electronic touch faucet, making it ideal for modern kitchens. With Advanced Recovery Technology™, it recovers up to 55% of water, saving up to 2X more water than conventional RO purifiers. Designed for borewell, tanker, and mixed water sources, it combines advanced purification, smart digital features, and elegant aesthetics.
